findings: The 2026-11-07 capture is a Terminal landing-page index: unchanged no-charge present-card collection purpose and five platform links, with immediate behavior/prerequisites/state detail delegated to the variants.

The prior raw header establishes 2026-05-01 as the capture date despite the 2025 filename. It is the retained functional evidence. substantive_changes: No new payment behavior is evidenced by the complete 2026-11-07 index. The disappearance of the five implementation sections from this capture provides no basis to infer feature removal, compatibility changes, or revised requirements.
historical_claims_to_preserve: 2026-05-01 documentation: collect without charging with a SetupIntent; collect consent and encrypted payment details through the reader and confirm via the selected integration; successful setup is succeeded, with a reusable generated_card when supported. The underlying card_present object cannot be charged online, and the generated card can be absent. The charge is CNP and the card-present liability shift/pricing do not apply.

Attach generated_card to the Customer before reuse: automatic successful attachment when Customer is provided at SetupIntent creation, or separate attachment. Expand latest_attempt or list attached card PaymentMethods. Accounts v2 customer-configured Account objects were recommended for most use cases, generally available to Connect users and in public preview for others requiring preview-version handling at that date.

Preserve the old allow_redisplay migration deadlines (March 31, 2025 non-React Native; September 30, 2025 React Native), always/limited consent semantics, and saved-wallet off-session-only limitation (limited; off_session=true at confirmation; use Apple Pay or Google Pay presentment for on-session). Preserve associated consent/compliance guidance as dated documentation.

Preserve card-network and reader specificity, JavaScript's separate collection/confirmation, server-driven process_setup_intent, iOS/Android 5.0.0 combined operation, and React Native 0.0.1-beta.29 combined option. The historical cancellation examples are platform-specific.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-directly, the 2026-11-07 capture states the no-charge present-card collection purpose for online reuse (new raw lines 5-7) and lists Server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native variant URLs (new raw lines 9-17). It establishes no additional SetupIntent prerequisites, actor responsibilities, or transitions. The 2026-05-01 capture describes a merchant integration setting up the Customer and SetupIntent and collecting the customer's consent before collecting and submitting payment details (old raw lines 16-30). In the server-driven example the merchant server creates a card_present SetupIntent, passes consent-appropriate redisplay and triggers reader collection/confirmation; Stripe's successful setup status is succeeded and any supported generated_card is a separate reusable online card PaymentMethod, automatically attached with the supplied Customer or attachable separately (old raw lines 54-62, old raw lines 78-104, old raw lines 114-122, old raw line 152). source-stripe-terminal-save-directly summarizes that earlier evidence, including CNP treatment, consent, SDK routes and wallet constraints, with the scope corrections recorded in the assessment.
